QuestInfo.name: Meeting Your Mentor
QuestInfo.0: You've successfully gotten yourself signed up as a private investigator. Talk to #b#p3001604##k to receive your first case.
QuestInfo.1: Kaling told you that rookies have to start by learning from those who know the ropes. Meet with Private Investigator #b#p3001605##k.
QuestInfo.2: You decided to accept Farasi as your mentor. Your exciting life as a private investigator is finally beginning!

npc.0: It's not good manners to keep a client waiting. Fortunately for you, the person you need to see is #b#p3001605##k, who's right over there. Yellow eyes, blue skin; you can't miss her.
